violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the Quaternary Ammonium Compound (QAC) solution was measured at ZERO ppm. This concentration is below the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of QAC solution at 200 ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SUGAR. SUGAR noted in a stainless steel container was not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.corrected during the inspection. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Availability of Cleaning Agents
violations.observation: There are no cleaning agents for cleaning equipment and utensils available in the in the dispensing bottles at the 3-compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaning agents that are used to clean and sanitize equipment and utensils shall be provided and available for use in the dispensing bottles or containers at the 3-compartment sink, during operation. CORRECTED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored in Packaging
violations.observation: Exposed coffee filters were observed stored unprotected at the wall counter.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location that is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. In addition, the single-service items shall be kept in the original protective package or stored by using other means that afford protection from contamination until used. Place the exposed filters in their original plastic sleeves, in a bag, or covered container.
